1. Revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices. I recommend this, since it stops further overcharges and can be undone.
2. Refund or credit the 4,128.60 across the eight orders. This needs a decision from Lena or your team.

Please confirm option 1 and tell me how you want the overcharge handled. I can also send Lena a note on the error if you'd like.
